defeats.how: Cap faked a mental breakdown to lure Muldoon in close, and quickly defeated him even though Muldoon got off a shot.
defeats.evidence: Although Muldoon does fire a shot, he is quickly defeated.

defeats.how: Cap pointed out that Muldoon's shot had exposed the Manipulator as an android; the shock made it shut down and fall on its face.
defeats.evidence: This revelation is a shock to the Manipulator and he shuts down and falls on his face.
